summary: Full-stack testing of Aegis Rogue tower defense. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests passing across health, leaderboard (POST/GET with score sorting & _id excluded) and monetization (log/summary). Frontend: Start screen -> canvas transition works, all HUD elements render (nexus HP bar, gold=300, gems, wave, speed toggles, pause, sound, vault, leaderboard, top/bottom ad banners). Tower placement flow works: selecting archer + clicking near path deducts 100 gold; wave start spawns creeps; hero abilities present and clickable; tower upgrade panel (upgrade/sell) opens on tower click. Wave 1 cleared -> draft modal appeared with 3 cards; reroll opened ad-interstitial, 5s countdown enabled claim, card pick closes modal. Vault modal opens with 3 tabs (Affiliate Vault w/ offer cards, SpawnTap SDK showing 'Fallback Mock Mode' pill, Prestige Forge w/ prestige-btn). Leaderboard modal loads and displays backend entries including TEST_ names. SpawnTap SDK correctly falls back to mock mode when sdk.spawntap.com is unreachable.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing whitespace between wave count and status label: renders 'WAVE 0/20Standing by' / 'WAVE 1/208 hostiles' (the '8' is enemy count squished to '20'). Add a space or separator between wave text and hostiles/status text.

action_items: (Optional) Add a space/separator between wave counter and hostiles-status text in HUD wave indicator so it reads 'WAVE 1/20 · 8 hostiles' instead of 'WAVE 1/208 hostiles'.
critical_code_review_comments: engine.js is ~1140 lines - consider splitting into engine-core/render/combat modules for maintainability (>700 line threshold).

SpawnTap adapter is instantiated twice per mount in dev/StrictMode (2x 'Initializing SpawnTap Bridge' logs). Cleanup on useEffect return exists but adapter side-effects (script tag injection) may still duplicate. Non-critical in prod build.
Backend leaderboard has no cap on entries stored - consider TTL/prune for long-term growth.
seed_data_creation: Backend leaderboard now has TEST_ prefixed entries (TEST_Hero, TEST_High, TEST_Low, etc.) and TEST_user monetization events used for regression.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright approach for tower placement: canvas is 960x560 world, letterboxed. Compute scale=min(cw/960, ch/560), offsets, then world (140, 60) is a valid buildable spot (near first horizontal path segment). Set speed 3x via hud-speed-3x to advance waves faster; wave 1 clears in ~30-50s. Vault tabs use data-testid vault-tab-{offers|spawntap|prestige}.
